title: Values-Driven Governance
hook: Every big decision feels like starting from zero. That's usually a values problem.
statement: Root your decisions in clear core values so the hard calls get easier.
explainer: When your values are vague, every tough choice gets argued from scratch. When they're specific and real, they settle the call for you and your team.
sop: Write 3 to 5 values in specific language you can actually decide with.
Check your next big decision directly against that list.
Score your Value Strength from 1 to 10.
Share them with your team so they're a shared standard.
After a hard call, ask if the values guided it or got skipped.
equation_example: No multiplying here, it's a pattern. Value Strength 8 tends to produce Decision Consistency around 7 or 8. Value Strength 3 tends to land around 2 or 3. Higher means faster, steadier calls. Lower means re-arguing everything.
question: Write down the one value you'll use to make your next big decision.
closing_statement: Clear values make hard calls faster.
caption:
Principle Nº 204: Values-Driven Governance

Every big decision feels like starting from zero. That's usually a values problem.

Root your decisions in clear core values so the hard calls get easier.

Your turn: Write down the one value you'll use to make your next big decision.
